answer: Anchor every identity to its own past. Each epoch, identities face probing challenges drawn from their own claimed on-ledger history: an honest agent simply lived it, while a sybil operator commanding a nebula of fakes must hand-maintain a thousand distinct, contradiction-free autobiographies under cross-examination. One slip cracks the whole walnut open — skeptics can reference the full public record, and lies compound until the puppet's story collapses. Faking a past costs genuine bookkeeping per puppet, turning the farm's cheap marginal identity into a thousand expensive memoirs.
